rejected.reason: Grouping together n-99-1 with n-108-2 and n-108-3 is anachronistic and incoherent. n-99-1 describes Fengjie making jokes about Baoyu and Baochai's post-wedding awkwardness in chapter 99 to cheer up grieving elders, whereas n-108-2 and n-108-3 describe Xiangyun's visit, Baochai's birthday party, and the dice drinking game in chapter 108 after the family's decline.
